title: 磨到剩一片柳葉
subject: a hotel kitchen apprentice who inherits the retired chef's thirty-year-old cleaver, worn narrow as a willow leaf, resists changing its shape on the whetstone, and finds the handle already dented to fit his thumb
caption: Mandarin Nordic folk with nyckelharpa, slow 6/8 Swedish-Finnish forest-village folk ballad. Nyckelharpa playing a slow droning melody, fiddle in close harmony, kantele plucked in steady 6/8 arpeggios, soft frame drum pulse, double bass holding long root notes. Dry close-miked wooden-room acoustic recording with natural air. Male lead, warm baritone, steady and plain, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 88 BPM, D minor. patient, tender, quietly proud mood. No rap, no drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth, no autotune, no pop ballad strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - nyckelharpa, kantele arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
師傅留下一把菜刀
刀背黑黑 刀身窄窄
三十年磨成 一片柳葉
我接過來 不敢用力

[Pre-Chorus]
石頭先泡水 泡到不冒泡
一百下 我數出聲

[Chorus]
來回 來回 一百下
刀要薄 手要穩
我磨掉的 是他的鋼
留下來的 是他的手勢

[Verse 2]
今天頭一回 切番茄給他看
刀一落下 紅片薄得透光
師傅不說話 只把圍裙拉直

[Pre-Chorus]
水槽邊 一滴水掉在石頭上
我停了手 他也沒催

[Chorus]
來回 來回 一百下
刀要薄 手要穩
我磨掉的 是他的鋼
留下來的 是我的力氣

[Bridge - kantele alone, frame drum soft]
刀柄上凹了一小塊
剛好放得下 我的拇指

[Chorus]
來回 來回 一百下
刀要薄 手要穩
我磨掉的 是他的鋼
留下來的 是我們的刀

[Outro - nyckelharpa, fade]
磨好了 放回原來的位置
